The mirror is mandatory for every future stable and canary Desktop release.

criteria: Stable v0.7.7 and every future canary/stable Desktop release use the mandatory COS mirror gate before GitHub SHASUMS256.txt is published.
GitHub binaries are uploaded first; mirror jobs in desktop-release-mirror obtain temporary Tencent STS credentials through OIDC; COS verifies every allowlisted asset; checksum marker is last.
npm publish jobs may use GitHub OIDC only for npm provenance; only mirror jobs use Tencent OIDC variables and STS.
COS signed HEAD existence checks work with the actual STS role through the distinct COS HeadObject permission.
COS uploads forbid overwrite; identical retries succeed and byte conflicts fail closed.
CLI supports auto, cn, and global sources; COS timeout, 404, interruption, corruption, or SHA mismatch falls back to GitHub.
GitHub SHASUMS256.txt is always the checksum trust root.
All eight v0.7.7 objects are anonymously readable at releases/v0.7.7, match GitHub bytes and SHA-256, while anonymous list/write remain 403.
A fresh isolated rudder start --download-source cn install succeeds through COS and a broken mirror endpoint succeeds through GitHub fallback.
The final source passes required checks and the public release surfaces converge on v0.7.7.
state_inventory: auto: bounded COS/GitHub probe and fastest healthy route
COS unavailable, stalled, interrupted, 404, corrupt, or mismatched: remove partial bytes and retry GitHub
GitHub checksum missing or corrupt: fail closed
stable and canary: same mandatory mirror gate
server-only start: no Desktop mirror resolution
